name: Rec Leader in Training (RLIT) and Outdoor Education Camp Volunteers
org: City of Davis Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: You spend two weeks learning to lead camp games, crafts, bike safety and first aid. Then you interview and help at a city day camp for a week. Teens 14 to 16 can help at Camp Putah and other outdoor camps instead.
who_can_apply: RLIT: ages 13 to 15. Returning RLIT: ages 13 to 16, only if you finished RLIT before and were invited back. Outdoor Education Volunteer: ages 14 to 16 in the Summer 2026 RecGuide (the 2026 Summer Camp Handbook says 13 to 16); you need your own bike and helmet and must ride at least 10 miles a day. RLITs must clear a local records check.
pay_detail: Unpaid, and there is a program fee. Summer 2026 fees: RLIT $247 (Session 1) or $264 (Session 2). Returning RLIT $66. Outdoor Education Volunteer $122, paid only after you are accepted.
duration: RLIT 2026: Session 1 June 15 to July 2, Session 2 July 13 to 31, Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m., with week three spent volunteering at a camp (about 30 hours, 8:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.). Outdoor Education Volunteers work at least three weeks between June 15 and August 21.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 dates are not posted. Last cycle: summer 2026 registration for camps and programs other than Camp Putah, Trekkers and Horse Camps opened Wednesday, March 11, 2026 at 7:00 a.m. for Davis residents. Outdoor Education Volunteer applications were due Friday, March 27, 2026 by 4:00 p.m.
how_to_apply: RLIT: sign up on the city's WebTrac site when summer sign ups open. Returning RLITs must be approved first. Outdoor Education Volunteer: fill out the online form. The link is on the city's volunteer page. Then go to a group interview. Questions? Call 530-757-5626 or email csweb@cityofdavis.org.
notes: These facts come from the Summer 2026 Rec Guide and the 2026 camp handbook. The summer 2027 guide is not out yet. After RLIT, you go on a list for more volunteer hours. You may be asked back as a returning volunteer. The city's paid camp leader job starts at 15. So RLIT is a good first step. You need a bike and helmet for RLIT and Outdoor Education. Davis residents sign up first. Others sign up the next Monday. As of Oct 16, 2026, the volunteer page did not list camp volunteers.
